observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment resource observation, incremental coherence, and capability intelligence

request.projection_gap: The existing scheduler trace and ECI correlated owner execution identities and elapsed time but did not carry process-counter deltas for each owner interval.

outcome.interpretation: A prior resident attempt exposed substantial process-level I/O and memory use without identifying which stage or owner accounted for it. The process sample does not establish a Btrfs cause. Existing host resource samples also do not provide owner-pass attribution. This supports adding bounded process observations beside existing owner execution evidence.
outcome.scope: One previously observed resident failure and a source review of the existing owner-pass trace and ECI projection.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner executions lack bounded process-resource evidence
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment resource observation, coherence scheduling, and ECI
pressure_hypothesis.basis: An earlier resident process sample recorded high I/O and memory use but ended before a trace was available, while current owner-pass projections correlated execution IDs and elapsed time without process counters.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Sample the scheduler process around existing owner runners, link deltas to exact service execution IDs, retain a bounded ECI view, and make process and child-process attribution limits explicit.

measurement_limits: The prior process counters are not attributed to a specific owner, Store operation, or filesystem cause.
No new resident tick was run for this change; live per-owner counter values remain unobserved.
This observation identifies a missing evidence relationship, not a verified resource pressure or service failure.
